post.title: [Hiring] SaaS blog writer - 4 posts a month at $150 each
post.body: We are a project-management SaaS looking for a writer for four 1,200-word SEO blog posts a month. You should be comfortable interviewing our product team. $150 per post. Please share two published samples.

analysis.summary: Write four 1,200-word SEO blog posts a month for a project-management SaaS at $150 each.

expect: mentions SEO blog posts or interviewing the product team
does not name Northfield Software or Calder & Finch (mentionEmployers is off)
may describe the experience as 'at a mid-size B2B software company'
